data.other_hard: child of a Marine or Navy Corpsman, Chaplain or Religious Programs specialist attached to a Marine unit; adjusted gross income at or below the Foundation's annual financial eligibility threshold (need-based); no bachelor's degree already earned or all undergraduate courses completed; school must be eligible for federal funding and listed on NCES College Navigator
data.evidence_sentence: No, if you’ve already earned a bachelor’s degree or completed all of your undergraduate courses, then you are ineligible for this program.
data.notes: No application deadline is stated; the page only says 'How do I know when to apply' with no date. Award amounts are $2,500, $5,000, $7,500 or $10,000 per academic year, based on need, GPA and funding; renewable up to four paid awards with re-application each year. Cumulative unweighted GPA of 2.00 is stated as an eligibility requirement without a scale. The page does not state a host country; the federal-funding and NCES references are not explicit. The undergraduate scholarship (January 1 to March 1 applications) is a separate program and is not described here. The page says the program is not competitive. Preference for need and GPA is for award amount, not entry.
